codec.name: Voice decoder
codec.description: Turns what the model produces into sound. Shared by every voice, so it downloads once.

backbones.name: NeuTTS 2E — emotional
backbones.description: Reads with feeling — pick happy, sad, angry, fearful, disgusted, surprised or neutral. A third the size of the others and about three times as fast, which makes it the one to use for long reading. Only its four built-in speakers; it cannot copy your voice.

backbones.name: NeuTTS Air — Q4
backbones.description: The one to start with. Smallest build that still sounds like the full model, and the quickest to speak.

backbones.name: NeuTTS Air — Q5
backbones.description: A little more detail than Q4 for about 35 MB more. Worth trying if Q4 sounds thin to you.

backbones.name: NeuTTS Air — Q8
backbones.description: Closest to the original model. Bigger, and slower to speak — best kept for a fast phone.

backbones.name: NeuTTS Air — Q2
backbones.description: The smallest download. Still clear, but rougher around the edges — for when space matters most.

backbones.name: NeuTTS Air — Hindi
backbones.description: Hindi, contributed by the community and labelled a preview by its author — expect rough edges.

encoder.name: Voice cloning
encoder.description: Optional. Lets you record your own voice - or anyone's, with their permission - and have the app speak in it. Without this you can still use the nine voices that come built in.
